32#define QDMI_MAKE_VERSION(major, minor, patch) \
33 ((((uint32_t)(major) & 0x3FFU) << 22U) | \
34 (((uint32_t)(minor) & 0x3FFU) << 12U) | ((uint32_t)(patch) & 0xFFFU))
35
37#define QDMI_VERSION_MAJOR(version) (((uint32_t)(version) >> 22U) & 0x3FFU)
39#define QDMI_VERSION_MINOR(version) (((uint32_t)(version) >> 12U) & 0x3FFU)
41#define QDMI_VERSION_PATCH(version) ((uint32_t)(version) & 0xFFFU)
